name: PGCMLS VolunTEEN Book Review Program
org: Prince George's County Memorial Library System

offerings.summary: Prince George's County students write book reviews for the library's teen readers and earn up to six service hours a school year, one hour per review.

grades.raw: Students in grades 6-12 who live in Prince George's County

residency.raw: who live in Prince George's County

sched.dur_raw: Runs during the school year; earn up to 6 service hours per school year, each review worth 1 hour

issues: Reviews are submitted through an online platform, so the role is recorded as virtual; the library does not state whether any in-branch attendance is required
